Disenchant values in tooltips and a buy-to-disenchant list
Auction house autopilot reworked

Community page: bug reports, suggestions and the Top reporters board in the app
Report bugs and suggest ideas from the game (/ff bug, /ff suggest)
Combat helper: more knowledge from written tutorials and videos

Advisor steps shown on the map

Quest helper with map and minimap pins

suggestions.text: Show the chosen build on the Talents window
Switch the app to the character you play
Gear finder: stat gains of each upgrade
Advisor steps on the map
A visual pass over the windows
Choose an older version in the app
A page on the game's rules
Controller support
Leveling route guide: the next town or camp for your race and level in the Advisor, with the arrow
Realized profit counts the buy price of every item sold, also across characters
Auction buying keeps a gold reserve so a character is never drained
Auction flips favour items that sell fast (fewer cheaper listings ahead)
Security review of updates and report sending
Profession planner clean-up: no overlapping or cut-off lines, clearer wording
Disenchant and enchanting profits: disenchant value against auction price, and a buy-to-disenchant list
Opt-in gold scoreboard: the most profitable FlipForever players
Dungeon advisor: which dungeon around your level has the most upgrades for your build
Best time to post: the hours your auctions sell best, shown when posting
Price chart in the Deals tab: price and amount listed over the last 14 days
Send to alt: mail crafting materials and auction stock to another of your characters in one click
Vendor resale finder: limited vendor items that sell for more on the auction house, with the merchant on the map
Bag space aware buying: auction buying stops before your bags are full
Auction session summary: what you bought, posted and sold when you close the auction house
Gold goals: set a daily or weekly profit goal and follow your progress
Restock reminders: a reminder to craft and post again when your crafted items sell out
Craft button in the profession planner: craft the top recipe the planned number of times
Less clutter in the addon and the app, and a smaller download
Realm overview in the app: profit, gold and characters per realm side by side
Enemy player alert on PvP realms while gathering or questing
New realm head start: rough price estimates from your other realm until the new one is scanned
Weekly report in the app: best and worst flips, fastest sellers, what to stop buying
Profession cooldowns for all your characters
Expiry saver: better options for items that keep expiring
Quiet chat option for role-play realms
Crafting cost in item tooltips
Talents by level: the talent to take at every level for the build you choose
Watch list price alerts (/ff watch)
Item counts of all your characters in tooltips
Login recap: auctions that ended while you were away
Aging stock in the app
Find an item across your characters (/ff find)
Market flood warning: skip items listed far above their usual amount
Deposit for 12, 24 and 48 hours in tooltips at the auction house
Export trades, inventory and the weekly report to CSV
Risky gathering spots on PvP realms
Sell-now signal for items priced well above usual
Falling price warning for items you hold
Best day to buy: the weekday an item is cheapest
Materials for the top recipe added to the shopping list
Rising markets on the Dashboard
Profitable recipe alert: after a scan, the addon names recipes you know that became clearly profitable to craft and sell.
Auction fees report in the app: the auction house cut and lost deposits per week and per item.
Sell alerts on the watch list: /ff watch sell tells you when an item you hold is listed at or above your price.
Your last sale in item tooltips: when you last sold an item and for how much each.
Item notes: a short personal note per item, shown in its tooltip and in the app.
Budget split across characters: the app suggests how to share your flipping gold between your characters.
Speak in dialect: a chat tool that rewrites what you type in a lore dialect, in six languages, with autocorrect.
More voices for the dialect chat tool (Forsaken, Tauren, Night Elf, Skyborne) and an Emote channel for roleplay.
Gold per hour: the app shows how much gold each character makes per hour played, over the last day and week, and how much of it comes from auction sales.
Relist helper: at the auction house, one button reposts every expired auction from the mailbox and bags at today's sell price (never below the floor), so expire
